the-registry-page-tasks.text: Story, requirements and refusals are in the spec; slices, gate and signatures are in the plan. One writer, commits per slice, each commit builds. Every check is run failing before it is made to pass, and the failing run is kept.

slice-1-lineage-facts.text: [ ] lineage-facts-red: a replay of a known history, with repeated and re-terminated keys, reports the create, the folds and the distinct keys; the test fails on the base.
[ ] replay-reports-named-keys: Replayed carries the keys the applied updates named.
[ ] snapshot-carries-lineage: the snapshot reports PublicLineage; the fixture snapshot says it has none; the three replay expectations of the end-to-end suite name the keys.

slice-2-page-value.text: [ ] page-render-red: determinism, same-facts-in-both-renderings and version refusal checks fail on the base.
[ ] page-value-and-renderers: Page, ReleaseInfo, releaseLinks, parseVersionLabel, describeRegistry, renderPageText, renderPageJson.

slice-3-describe-command.text: [ ] describe-parse-red: write settings refused by name; a missing token; --json accepted.
[ ] describe-command: the argument record, the subcommand, the usage lines, the dispatch.

[ ] describe-composition: release and version.txt read at the composition boundary, session opened for reading, selection, leaf reads over the named keys, pending requests through the inspect renderer, success prints the page, refusal prints the usual receipt.
[ ] describe-controls: foreign blueprint refused; missing and malformed version.txt refused; no file appears under a state directory.

slice-4-two-actor-journey.text: [ ] staged-release: the journey stages the blueprint and version.txt as the archive lays them.
[ ] page-readings: each actor describes before booking, after their own fold, in text and in JSON, twice, and the receipts are kept.
[ ] page-rows-computed: the two page rows are computed from those receipts against inspect and the fold receipts; removing one receipt turns its row pending; the exit status no longer excuses them.
[ ] home-unchanged: the actor's home tree is the same before and after a page.
[ ] harness-controls: the status test and both control wrappers cover the new rows.

slice-5-help-and-docs.text: [ ] help-and-flags: usage text and the flags page agree, and the flags check refuses a planted disagreement.

[ ] registry-page-docs: a page with the story, a diagram, a sample page generated by the tool from the journey, the refusals and the limits; the onboarding page says what is delivered and what is not; navigation entry.
[ ] narration-regenerated: speech companions from the extraction tool, stale clips regenerated with the authorized key, unchanged clips reused, docs/audio/ committed alone.

slice-6-archive-version.text: [ ] archive-stages-version: version.txt beside the archive's blueprint.
[ ] release-check-refuses-disagreement: missing, other or unchecksummed version refused by name.

close.text: [ ] final-local-gate: lint, format, focused suites, flags, docs, then just ci once.
[ ] pull-request-record: the template filled with the model revision, maps, evidence and limits.

second-pull-request-starts-after-the-des.text: Second pull request (starts after the desk's notes that create funding and the bookkeeping work merged).

slice-7-create-prints-the-command.text: [ ] create-prints-describe-command-red: the create receipt carries no describe command on the base; the test runs the printed command as printed and expects the page.
[ ] create-receipt-carries-the-command: built from the arguments create ran with, with the new state token, never a wallet key; both the registry and the open-datum create.

slice-8-page-from-the-archive.text: [ ] run-page-starts-from-the-page: Demo 1's run page gets the page as its first reading after create.

[ ] archive-job-runs-describe: the archive job extracts the release, runs the archive's own singular and blueprint with the adjacent version.txt, and compares the page with inspect after the lifecycle; commands and outputs are recorded.
[ ] run-page-step-check-follows: the numbered-step check and its controls follow the new step.
[ ] narration-and-docs-follow: speech and clips regenerated for the changed pages.
